title: ChatGPT Wallet: agents shop, but you sign off
hook: 你叫 AI 幫你下單，它拿著你的信用卡站在收銀台前，卻不敢刷。
bridge: OpenAI 不敢一口氣全面開放，只讓少數用戶先試試水溫。
p: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, letting its AI agents check out for users. For now it is open only to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US who are 18 or older. Nothing is bought until the user {0} each purchase with a biometric check, and the agent pays with a substitute card number, so it never sees the real one.

The rollout is narrow on purpose. OpenAI is {1} here: American Express, Mastercard and Visa are partners, and OpenAI takes no cut of purchases at launch. Not every shop is ready, though. United Airlines will block AI agents from booking tickets, and Amazon does not let them buy on its site.
inText: dipping a toe in the water

words.def: to officially approve something so that it can go ahead
words.mn: AI 把購物單遞到你面前，你拿筆在簽名欄簽下名字，單子才蓋章生效。簽了名才放行，就是 sign off on。
words.ex: The board has to sign off on the budget before we hire anyone.
words.exZh: 董事會得先批准預算，我們才能開始招人。

words.term: dip a toe in the water
words.def: to try something new in a small, careful way before committing fully
words.mn: OpenAI 站在泳池邊，只把一根腳趾伸進水裡，先讓 Pro 用戶試用。腳趾先試水溫，就是小規模試試看。
words.ex: The bank is dipping a toe in the water with a small crypto pilot.
words.exZh: 這家銀行先以小規模的加密貨幣試辦計畫試水溫。

quiz.q: The manager has to ___ every expense over $500.
quiz.why: sign off on 是正式批准。run out of 是用完，look down on 是瞧不起。

quiz.q: The restaurant chain is ___ with a single delivery-only kitchen before expanding.
opts: dipping a toe in the water
quiz.why: dip a toe in the water 是小規模試水溫。burn the candle 是過度操勞，rock the boat 是搗亂現狀。
